excerpt: The E158 experiment at SLAC has made the first measurement of parity violation in electron-electron (Moller) scattering. We report a preliminary result using 50% of the accumulated data sample for the right-left parity-violating cross-section asymmetry (APV) in the elastic scattering of 45 and 48 Ge
publisher: M. Woods for the SLAC E158 Collaboration / SLAC Summer Institute 2003
title: A New Measurement of the Weak Mixing Angle (SLAC Summer Institute 2003 proceedings)
